summary: Opaque native addon containing browser credential/cookie stealer primitives
details: Package ships as its sole artifact a ~10MB stripped Rust-compiled Node.js napi addon (tools.linux-x64-gnu.node) declared as main, with no source, no repository, no homepage, a one-line README, and a timestamp-suffixed pseudo-version (3.1.40-browser-release-151-375-1784897296). Strings embedded in the binary correspond to browser credential-store access and exfiltration tooling: SQLite auth handling and a 'Found login for' log line consistent with Chromium Login Data extraction, 'Cookie.value when inserting' consistent with Cookies store parsing, host-fingerprinting probes against /etc/lsb-release, /dev/disk/by-id/, and network_adapters, an embedded ureq HTTP+TLS client, and zip/zstd compression primitives forming an archive-and-upload pipeline. The 'browser-release' tag in the version string self-labels the target. The package is a platform-suffixed side package (-linux-x64-gnu) intended to be pulled in as an optionalDependency by a wrapper package so that installing it drops non-inspectable native capability into the installer's dependency graph.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
